questions.question: Why should startup and performance numbers be taken from release builds rather than development builds?
options: Development builds cannot run on physical devices
Profilers only attach to App Store builds
Dev builds add checks and run JS from source instead of precompiled bytecode, so their numbers are much worse and misleading
questions.explanation: Dev mode includes extra validation and tooling, and Hermes doesn't use precompiled bytecode there, so it doesn't represent what users experience.

questions.question: What does `adb shell am start -W -n <package>/.MainActivity` report?
options: The size of the JS bundle
Launch timing such as TotalTime until the activity's first frame
questions.explanation: With -W the activity manager waits for launch and prints timing like TotalTime and WaitTime, a quick way to measure cold start on Android.

questions.question: An app initialises analytics, chat support and remote config in index.js and starts slowly. What is a good first change?
options: Defer non-critical SDK initialisation until after the first render
Move all code into one giant component
questions.explanation: Everything at module top level runs before the first frame. Deferring non-essential SDKs shortens the critical path to first content.

questions.question: Memory keeps climbing each time a user opens and closes a screen. Which code pattern is a likely cause?
options: Adding an AppState or other event listener in useEffect without removing it in the cleanup function
questions.explanation: Listeners and timers that are never cleaned up keep their closures alive after unmount, so memory grows with every visit.
